summary: Explains what it means for a domain name to be reserved for special use, when that is appropriate, and the procedure for doing it. It establishes an IANA registry of such names and seeds it with entries for some already established special domain names. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Some names in the internet phone book are held back for special jobs, like reserved parking spots. This memo says how a spot gets reserved and keeps a public list.

questions: how to reserve a special-use domain name
